LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony has been taken on as a hireling of House Redoran. The house expects duty and honor, and pays for both.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Enlist_Button_Desc: Swear to House Redoran, the warrior house of Morrowind. Duty first, always.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Enlist_Requrements_Not: House Redoran does not yet trust your honor. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fa: House Redoran will not take the oath of its enemies.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Missions_Desc: See what the councilors need done.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Menu_Missions_Desc: Duties assigned by the Redoran council. Paid when completed.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Provisions_Desc: Scuttle, saltrice and a little sujamma.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in a Redoran council hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave House Redoran? They will think less of your honor.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has left House Redoran.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your place in House Redoran.
LanguageData.ESCP_HouseRedoran_Kick_Out_Label_Title: House Redoran has judged the colony without honor.
